word_format_structure.TOTAL_DURATION: 20 µs per word (3 µs sync + 16 µs data + 1 µs parity)
word_format_structure.SYNC_FIELD: 3 µs, NON-Manchester. Command/Status: HIGH 1.5 µs then LOW 1.5 µs. Data: LOW 1.5 µs then HIGH 1.5 µs.
word_format_structure.DATA_FIELD: 16 bits × 1 µs = 16 µs. Manchester II bi-phase, MSB-first.
word_format_structure.PARITY_FIELD: 1 bit × 1 µs = 1 µs. Odd parity over the 16 data bits.

manchester_encoding_waveform.LOGICAL_1: First half-bit HIGH (0.5 µs) then second half-bit LOW (0.5 µs).
manchester_encoding_waveform.LOGICAL_0: First half-bit LOW (0.5 µs) then second half-bit HIGH (0.5 µs).
manchester_encoding_waveform.MID_BIT_TRANSITION: Mandatory mid-bit edge; receivers recover clock from this transition.
manchester_encoding_waveform.NO_DC_COMPONENT: Average voltage over any bit-cell is zero (transformer-friendly).

sync_waveform.COMMAND_STATUS_SYNC: 3 µs total: HIGH for 1.5 µs immediately followed by LOW for 1.5 µs. Cannot occur in Manchester payload (no payload sequence produces 1.5 µs sustained high then 1.5 µs sustained low).
sync_waveform.DATA_SYNC: 3 µs total: LOW for 1.5 µs immediately followed by HIGH for 1.5 µs. Inverse polarity of Command/Status sync. Cannot occur in Manchester payload.

message_waveform.BC_TO_RT_TRANSFER: BC: Receive-Command-Word (20 µs) → BC: N×Data-Word (20 µs each) → 4-12 µs response gap → RT: Status-Word (20 µs) → ≥ 4 µs inter-message gap.
message_waveform.RT_TO_BC_TRANSFER: BC: Transmit-Command-Word (20 µs) → 4-12 µs response gap → RT: Status-Word (20 µs) → RT: N×Data-Word (20 µs each) → ≥ 4 µs inter-message gap.
message_waveform.RT_TO_RT_TRANSFER: BC: Receive-Command (to RT2) (20 µs) → BC: Transmit-Command (to RT1) (20 µs) → 4-12 µs gap → RT1: Status (20 µs) → RT1: N×Data (20 µs each) → 4-12 µs gap → RT2: Status (20 µs) → ≥ 4 µs inter-message gap.
message_waveform.MODE_WITHOUT_DATA: BC: Mode-Command (20 µs) → 4-12 µs gap → RT: Status (20 µs) → ≥ 4 µs gap.
message_waveform.MODE_WITH_DATA_TRANSMIT: BC: Mode-Command (20 µs) → 4-12 µs gap → RT: Status (20 µs) → RT: 1×Data (20 µs) → ≥ 4 µs gap.
message_waveform.MODE_WITH_DATA_RECEIVE: BC: Mode-Command (20 µs) → BC: 1×Data (20 µs) → 4-12 µs gap → RT: Status (20 µs) → ≥ 4 µs gap.
message_waveform.BROADCAST_TRANSFER: Same as BC-to-RT format but RT address = 31. RTs DO NOT transmit Status Word.

broadcast_waveform_special: Broadcast (RT address 31): receiving RTs accept the Data Word(s) but DO NOT transmit a Status Word — the Status Word slot is left silent to prevent multiple-RT collision on the bus.
dual_redundant_bus_waveform: Bus A and Bus B carry the same protocol independently. A message is launched on only one of the two buses; the redundant bus is electrically idle. On no-response or error, the BC may retransmit the same message immediately on the redundant bus.
rt_supersede_rule: If the BC asserts a new Command/Status sync while an RT is still transmitting its response, the RT must abort its own transmission and treat the new BC word as the next command (supersede).
max_message_length_us: Command (20 µs) + 32 × Data (640 µs) + 12 µs gap + Status (20 µs) ≈ 692 µs for max-payload RT-to-BC or BC-to-RT (excluding final inter-message gap).
